# Daily Report — 2026-09-14

## Task Completed
Added `create_ci_affinity`, `update_ci_affinity`, and `delete_ci_affinity` tools to complete
full CRUD for the cmdb_ci_affinity table. `list_ci_affinities` and `get_ci_affinity` already
existed; this adds the write path.

- `create_ci_affinity` — POST cmdb_ci_affinity; required name field; optional affinity_type
  (type), active (serialised as string), description, scope (app-scope sys_id), condition
  (encoded query string).
- `update_ci_affinity` — PATCH cmdb_ci_affinity/{sys_id}; all fields optional; empty-body
  guard; 404 guard.
- `delete_ci_affinity` — DELETE cmdb_ci_affinity/{sys_id}; 404 guard; 204/200 success handling.
- Three new Pydantic param models: `CreateCIAffinityParams`, `UpdateCIAffinityParams`,
  `DeleteCIAffinityParams`.
- All three tools registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, and both `system_administrator`
  and `full` packages in `tool_packages.yaml`.
- 21 new tests covering create/update/delete success paths, all optional-field branches,
  empty-body guard, 404 guards, HTTP errors, network errors, and param model validation.

## Test Results
- Total tests: 3737 passed, 4 deselected
